name: Gatekeeper by SocialBrand
title: Gatekeeper — Browser-Access Control for Bot Fleets
description: By SocialBrand · socialbrand.africa. Security-first access control for bots that share one computer. It decides which bot may use which signed-in service, checks logins each weekday morning, and watches for services that block AI agents.

companion.name: Token Cop
companion.reason: Keeps the same fleet of bots within its AI usage limits, while Gatekeeper controls what each bot may reach.

companion_main.name: Grok Bot Setup Coach
companion_main.reason: Sets up each new bot in one sitting. Gatekeeper then controls what that bot may reach.

avatar_approved_note: Option A (navy shield with a white tick) is the live avatar. Options B and C are not made yet. Publisher sign-off still needed.
